lesson.title: Wonder Through Antifragility
lesson.topic: Exploring how embracing uncertainty and wonder can make us more antifragile in our thinking and decision-making.
lesson.steelman: How can we apply the concept of antifragility to our approach to knowledge acquisition and problem-solving?
lesson.example: Discussing a scientist who thrives on challenging hypotheses with novel data, thereby making their theories stronger over time.

rationale: This lesson bridges the gap between philosophical wonder and practical decision-making frameworks like antifragility.
